research_question: How the high-nickel to lithium-hydroxide demand thesis changed across the 2018 and 2019 Q1 knowledge vintages, why it changed, and what was knowable at each point in time.

source_policy.principle: Verifiable formal listed-company announcements and filings may be acquired from reputable financial announcement databases, programmatic trading/financial data interfaces, or open-source announcement/data projects without automatic authority downgrade when the actual announcement payload and upstream identity are preserved and cross-checkable.
required_provenance: upstream accession, filing id or announcement id
source_policy.derived_data_boundary: Metrics, ratios, standardized fields, classifications, forecasts or other values computed by an interface or project do not inherit the authority of an underlying filing and require separate claim-scoped assessment.
source_policy.independence_boundary: Multiple redistributors carrying the same upstream announcement remain one evidence cluster rather than independent corroboration.
source_policy.open_source_search_result: A bounded search of SEC downloader/crawler repositories found acquisition code but no stored Livent target filing payload; open-source code alone was not treated as Evidence.

sources.upstream_system: Livent issuer release / SEC EDGAR Exhibit 99.1
sources.upstream_title: Livent Corporation Announces First Quarter 2019 Results

acquisition.transport_decision: The successful redistributor payloads removed direct SEC byte retrieval from the critical path. The Q1 10-Q remains useful corroboration but its raw bytes are no longer required for this trajectory because the issuer-supplied May 7 results release directly states the contemporaneous timing revision and mechanism.

judgments.semantic_summary: Structural thesis: increasing high-nickel cathode adoption would increase the requirement for battery-grade lithium hydroxide.
Near-term timing/strength revision: meaningful high-nickel-driven high-performance hydroxide demand was not expected until late 2019 or early 2020 and full-year volume/pricing forecasts were reduced.

rationales.semantic_summary: Several major customers delayed commercial launches of high-nickel cathode chemistries, reducing near-term high-performance lithium hydroxide deliveries relative to prior indication.

cognition.relation_decision: No formal REVISES relation was created. The 2018 grounded object is a structural demand thesis while the 2019 grounded object is a near-term timing/strength forecast, so same-granularity revision identity is not established. The later vintage narrows near-term expectations without withdrawing the structural thesis.

outcome_decision.reason: EVT-003 is a cognition-vintage trajectory. No later source-backed outcome with sufficiently comparable semantics was required to prove the historical expectation revision, and creating one merely to fill a Reality/Judgment/Outcome template would manufacture comparability.

next_research_direction: EVT-003 is complete enough to stop local optimization. Move to the next semantically orthogonal trajectory inside sealed UP-CHEMICALS that can force a different cross-industry primitive or prove existing abstractions without reopening source-transport infrastructure.
